definition: This dimension controls how skills learned in one context can influence or enhance skills in another, varying from strict isolation to extensive cross-training benefits. It explores whether skills can be easily transferred between different activities or whether they remain compartmentalized.
exclusion_criteria: Skills are completely isolated with no transfer benefits
Skills only improve through a predefined leveling system without practical use
inclusion_criteria: Skills can influence each other across different contexts
Training in one skill can provide bonuses to unrelated skills
title: Skill Transfer Mechanisms
